race.comment: AFFAMATO (1) turned in a much better run at his latest appearance when he scored by 4.5 metres over 1680m at Launceston. Likely to get all the favours from this nice draw. This is a nice drop in grade so he is sure to prove tough to beat again. BAIL DENIED (10) continued the strong recent form when he scored last start over 1680m at Launceston. Will need an ounce of luck to slot in from this tricky draw. Steps up a level but he is up to the task. GOODTIME OSCAR (9) is in the mix following a respectable second at his most recent appearance over 1609m at this track. SMOOTH REASON (2) should not have any excuses from the favourable draw. Include in exotic bets.
